description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka - Implementing Standards issued under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette content involves the issuance of implementing standards under the Civil Aviation Act No. 14 of 2010, which constitutes regulatory matters and legal frameworks. It contains a schedule of mandatory standards and regulations for civil aviation operations, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory content rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
